At today's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple confirmed the rollout schedule for the new Siri AI, which will debut in English first and expand to five additional languages in October. Details below.

Siri AI language expansion confirmed for October launch

Apple today unveiled its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Apple also announced the Apple Watch Series 12 Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The common thread across all these devices is that each will feature one or more capabilities of the new Siri AI, which is built on Apple's partnership with Google to deliver a more powerful large language model assistant experience.

Apple first previewed Siri AI earlier this year at WWDC, and today provided a more concrete timeline for language support.

Apple's VP of AI product marketing, Lilian Rincon, said at the event that the new Siri AI will debut in English when iOS 27 officially launches on September 14, with the following languages gaining support in October:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Rincon also confirmed two pieces of information that Apple's Craig Federighi had mentioned earlier this year at WWDC.

First, some features will have usage limits because they rely on heavy-duty server-side models, with most iCloud+ plans bundling in additional usage allowances.

Second, Apple Intelligence (of which Siri AI is only a part) will support the following 16 languages in this month's OS updates:

  • English
  • Simplified Chinese
  • Traditional Chinese
  • Danish
  • Dutch
  • French
  • German
  • Italian
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Norwegian
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish
  • Swedish
  • Turkish
  • Vietnamese

Apple noted that Apple Intelligence is not available in China, though the company appears to be working behind the scenes to bring these features to that market. Apple also mentioned that Siri AI will not launch in China and the EU, as Apple and EU regulators remain at odds over the Digital Markets Act.
